options.content: **Application performance** — RED metrics derived from traces by the Collector's *spanmetrics* connector, JVM runtime metrics from the Java agent, slow traces from Tempo. Logs are in Kibana (http://localhost:5601). Services appear here as you instrument them.

panels.title: Bank services
panels.description: Blackbox exporter calls each service's /health/ready every 15 s.

panels.title: Services — throughput, response time, errors, Apdex
panels.description: One row per service. Rates use the last 5 minutes; Transactions and Errors cover the dashboard time range. A transaction is one incoming request (server span). Apdex T = 200 ms: 1.0 = every request under 200 ms. Empty cells: no requests in the last 5 minutes, or the service is not instrumented yet (Go and .NET: Phase 5 Step 4).

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m])) / (sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m]))) >= 0

100 * (sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m]))) / (sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m])) > 0)

round(sum by (service_name) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (service_name) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[$__range])))

(sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*", le="200.0"}[5m])) + sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*", le="800.0"}[5m]))) / 2 / (sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Requests per minute (rpm) over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Transactions
panels.description: Incoming requests in the dashboard time range.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: Apdex
panels.description: T = 200 ms. 1.0 = all requests satisfied; below 0.7 users notice slowness.

targets.expr: (sum (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*", le="200.0"}[5m])) + sum (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*", le="800.0"}[5m]))) / 2 / (sum (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m])) > 0)

sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m]))

panels.title: p95 latency by service (dots = exemplars → click to open the trace)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m])))

panels.title: Error % by service
panels.description: Server spans marked as errors (5xx). 4xx responses such as a wrong OTP are not errors.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m]))) / sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[5m]))

panels.title: Top transactions — busiest endpoints (last hour)
panels.description: Requests per endpoint over the last hour, highest first.

targets.expr: topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, span_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /health.*"}[1h]))) > 0)

panels.title: Calls each service makes (last hour) — slowest first
panels.description: Client and producer spans: SQL queries, Redis commands, HTTP calls to other services, RabbitMQ publishes.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name, span_name, span_kind) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name=~"$service", span_kind=~"SPAN_KIND_CLIENT|SPAN_KIND_PRODUCER"}[1h])) / sum by (service_name, span_name, span_kind) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"$service", span_kind=~"SPAN_KIND_CLIENT|SPAN_KIND_PRODUCER"}[1h]))

panels.title: Time spent in outgoing calls by service
panels.description: Seconds per second spent waiting on databases, caches, other services and RabbitMQ.

panels.title: GC pause time per second
panels.description: Seconds spent in garbage collection per second of wall time.

panels.title: Slow requests (> 200 ms) — click a Trace ID
